memo: Incumbent mean_adjusted is 1.1146 over 16 runs. Of 12 table rows, only the momentum-ramp flag (slot 2, official 1.1129, delta -0.0016) beat it. That gain is tiny and unreplicated, so replicate it before trusting it. Everything else was worse. Bigger batches hurt most (2^20 tokens: 1.1926, +0.0781). Warmup was also bad (1.2105, +0.0959). The larger total optimization budget was bad too (1.1839, +0.0694). Halving DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE to 32 was worse (1.2071, +0.0925). Small optimizer and regularization tweaks lost slightly: beta2 0.999 (+0.0051), higher early LR multipliers (+0.0045), cosine decay (+0.0036), weight decay 0.1 (+0.0018), Muon beta ramp (+0.0015). Depth 12 crashed (one run, no result), and the bias-term idea was aborted. Next: replicate the momentum ramp. Then try small single-variable changes, such as weight decay above 0.2 or a warmdown tweak. Avoid large jumps in batch, depth or budget, and watch memory.
